digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge noun and subcommand dispatch
propositions: bridge preview and bridge sync subcommands must be functional with preview performing read-only operations and sync performing mutations
legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck) and rebar doctor must remain fully functional without breaking existing workflows or consumers
the bridge noun dispatch must not advertise unimplemented verbs and must prevent nested names from falling through to top-level commands
MODE_CAPS, Mode rank ladder, and gated_mode reconcile-check round-trip must survive intact
user guide, CLI reference, and release notes must document only the staged surface (preview and sync) that actually ships
all in-repo consumers and library callers must keep working at the story boundary
